title: Growth Agent
subtitle: Service Overview
author: Joe Wotherspoon
lead: A team of AI agents grows your business three ways at once: get found on Google and in AI answers, pay to be seen with Google, Meta and LinkedIn ads, and go get clients with targeted LinkedIn and email outreach. Your logo shows next to every email you send. Nothing is sent, spent or published without your sign-off.
services: Technical audit and fixes, keyword map, page rewrites, structured data, Google Business Profile, visibility in ChatGPT, Perplexity and AI Overviews
A site Google can fully read, pages aimed at searches that bring customers, a stronger local listing
Google Search, Meta and LinkedIn campaign plans, competitor ad research, conversion tracking, ad copy
Campaigns ready to switch on, plus a 30-day test with a target cost per lead
Ideal client profile, named best-fit businesses with a reason to contact each now, LinkedIn and email sequences per prospect
20–50 qualified prospects a round, emails waiting as drafts in your Gmail, a tracker sheet
SPF, DKIM and DMARC fixes, logo prepared to Gmail's standard, BIMI record and certificate
Better inbox placement, and your logo (plus a blue tick with a trademark) beside every email
results: Technical errors that stop Google indexing the site, fixed and re-checked
Richer search listings: site name, business details, review stars where they qualify
Pages aimed at searches that make money, not vanity traffic
A site AI assistants can read and quote
A steady pipeline of named prospects, each with a current reason to talk
More email in the inbox, and a logo that stands out once BIMI is live
results_note: Typical outcomes, not guarantees. Nobody can promise a Google ranking, and we never quote invented figures.
example: Worked example: on our own portfolio site, the audit found 5 gaps. All were fixed in one pass and the audit score went from 95 to 100.
approach: the site, tracking, email setup, and current presence in search and AI answers
searches you can win, competitors' live ads, the businesses most likely to buy
technical and on-page issues in the site itself, plus the DNS records
content, campaigns (paused until you approve) and outreach drafts
impressions, cost per lead, reply rates, inbox placement; re-audit monthly
gate: A lead agent runs all three in parallel. You approve anything sent, spent or published.
needs: access to the website (or its code), Google Search Console and Analytics, the DNS settings for your email domain, any ad accounts, a monthly ad budget, your logo as a vector file, and 30 minutes a week to approve campaigns and outreach.
footer_left: Ads: days · Outreach: weeks · Organic search: 2–4 months
